There is a sagelet in \textit{sagelets.org} to check the duplications.

<!-- head-2: body_md -->
\textit{Are there quadrilaterals with more than five but not infinitely many quadrisections?}  My guess is no, but that is only a guess, based on many failed searches for one with more than five.
<!-- end head-2 -->
